document.title: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations
document.credit: Adapted from the paper by Alpöge and Buckmaster. Prepared by Will Cook with AI assistance.

notes: Reorganized the introduction around the recurrent reference flow, the obstruction posed by its tail, and the construction of finite-energy solutions on the whole space and torus.
Separated the finite-dimensional choice of initial velocity from the parameter correction that constructs a periodic profile.
Made explicit which conditions on the represented certificate data yield each analytic estimate, and how the radial phase enters the far-field residual.
Kept the numbered results and displayed equations in place and aligned the revised prose with the original paper and Lean source.
